Description:
Return whether the asynchronous operation has finished.
If this function returns true, get(), GetResult() and the wait calls are guaranteed not to block.
It shall be treated as a Violation if the Future is invalid (valid returns false). The standardized
log message is: "Calling is_ready() on an invalid Future is not allowed."
